usage: Accord de matières : Jardin de cottage
prompt:
A designer's material composition titled in spirit « Jardin de cottage »: real samples of Brique, Osier, Pierre sèche arranged together as an interior architect's still life, in the proportion Allées en brique · supports tressés · murets de pierre. Mood: Jardin anglais foisonnant, roses et vivaces.
Editorial still-life photograph for an interior design magazine, 85 mm lens, close framing where the material fills most of the frame, soft raking daylight from the side that reveals the texture, natural depth of field, true colour, no blown highlights.
LOCKS: no brand, no logo, no label, no text, no people.
